  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">

  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="sales-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start_inquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_inquire</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_approve_quote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_quote_approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_quote_declined</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_receive_confirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_order_confirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_sales_staff" name="Sales staff or customer support">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_collect_information</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_address_concerns</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_customer_interested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_not_interested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_sales_rep" name="Sales representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_guide_selection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_provide_quote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_place_order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_record_order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>task_send_confirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="start_inquiry" name="Potential customer inquires" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_inquire" name="Inquire about a product or service" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_collect_information" name="Collect relevant information" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_address_concerns" name="Address concerns or questions" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gw_customer_interested" name="Customer interested?" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_guide_selection" name="Guide the customer through selecting the product or service" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_provide_quote" name="Provide a quote" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_approve_quote" name="Approve the quote" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gw_quote_approved" name="Quote approved?" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_place_order" name="Place the order" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_record_order" name="Record the order in the system" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_send_confirmation" name="Send order confirmation" />
    <bpmn:task id="task_receive_confirmation" name="Receive order confirmation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_not_interested" name="Customer not interested" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_quote_declined" name="Quote declined" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_order_confirmed" name="Order placed and confirmed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start_inquiry" targetRef="task_inquire" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="task_inquire" targetRef="task_collect_information" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="task_collect_information" targetRef="task_address_concerns" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="task_address_concerns" targetRef="gw_customer_interested" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" name="no" sourceRef="gw_customer_interested" targetRef="end_not_interested" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="task_guide_selection" targetRef="task_provide_quote" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="task_provide_quote" targetRef="task_approve_quote" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="task_approve_quote" targetRef="gw_quote_approved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" name="yes" sourceRef="gw_quote_approved" targetRef="task_place_order" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" name="no" sourceRef="gw_quote_approved" targetRef="end_quote_declined" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="task_place_order" targetRef="task_record_order" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="task_record_order" targetRef="task_send_confirmation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" sourceRef="task_send_confirmation" targetRef="task_receive_confirmation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="task_receive_confirmation" targetRef="end_order_confirmed" />

</bpmn:definitions>
